body.mechanism: If supplied hourly NWP values are interval-shifted relative to their valid coordinate, exactly one frozen same-run mapping should align more strongly and robustly with training SCADA wind.
body.treatment: Four fixed t/t-1/adjacent-mean mappings on 8 NWP-height x farm panels with joint day bootstrap.
body.metric: Equal-panel Fisher-z wind correlation, simultaneous lower bound, strata votes, source-family sign and coverage; no power score.
